# azd Setup

Use this before running Agent Optimizer operations. This skill targets agent code repos that use azd and hosted agents.

## Verify prerequisites

Run from the selected agent repo:

bash
azd version
az login
azd ai agent --help
azd ai agent optimize --help


If `azd ai agent` is unavailable, install or update the `azure.ai.agents` azd extension using the official extension source. If the needed version is private preview only, ask the user for their approved extension source; d
